order_updated.rule: Do not publish order_updated for mutations after order_paid that would overwrite the Analytics sale snapshot.
order_updated.change_reasons: one or more stable enum values

payment_method: Stable technical key/handler identifier; display or translated labels are forbidden.

lead_won.rule: lead_status_changed to won requires order_id or manual_sale_id in envelope.
lead_won.conversion_source: Only order_paid or manual_sale_created creates the sale conversion fact.

transactional_outbox.transaction_rule: Business mutation and outbox insert commit in the same database transaction.
transactional_outbox.retry_event_id: Re-publication of one outbox record keeps the original event_id.
transactional_outbox.rabbitmq_unavailable: Business operation remains committed and the event remains pending in outbox.

input_deduplication.http_submit: Stable submission_id for one logical submit; duplicate submit must not create a second business fact.
input_deduplication.provider_webhook: Deduplicate by provider plus stable provider event/message id before creating a business fact.
input_deduplication.payment_callback: Deduplicate by payment provider plus stable callback/transaction id before creating a business fact.

contact_received.business_fact: Every confirmed contact creates one Contact and publishes contact_received.
contact_received.visitor_id: optional; may be absent for direct email/phone
lead_reuse: Use an explicit lead_id or trusted tracking reference when it unambiguously identifies a Lead.
Otherwise reuse exactly one open Lead only when visitor_id, sales_channel_id and same-contact rules match.
If topic/product differs, Lead is closed, or matching is ambiguous, create a new Lead.
Email/phone equality alone is not sufficient for automatic Lead merging.
contact_received.publishing: If a new Lead is created, publish both lead_created and contact_received. If an existing Lead is reused, publish contact_received only.
contact_received.pii: Raw name, email, phone and message text remain inside Shopware and are not published.
